replacement.notes: Finished Meshy visual for the VisualRoot of the C_candy witch's candy workshop exterior (Spec 6.3); in P2 it replaces W04's placeholder CCD_M04_CandyWorkshopProxy_001 (assets/manifest/C_candy.json, whose future_target is M04_WitchCandyWorkshop_001). origin_world is the asset-local origin: the world position is W04's (CCD_M04_CandyWorkshopProxy_001 at [38.0, 0.0, 0.0], rotation_z 90.0, as received.json placement_hint; the front looks west to the plaza). Origin = bottom centre (z=0), front = +Y (Resonite +Z). Building exterior only: no stalls, display, cauldron, candy machines or brooms (W04). The door is a relief and does not open (door bottom [-0.006, 2.128, 0.116]). Window glow: one material, the emission image M04_WitchCandyWorkshop_001_emission.png paints only the 17 window panes (modeling/M04/build.py WINDOWS); control it with the material's EmissiveColor in Resonite (black = off). No collider is part of this visual.
